name: Legendary Foods Protein Donuts — Cinnamon Crumble

source.author: Legendary Foods
source.notes: Requested via iHerb (il.iherb.com), egress-blocked by the proxy. Values from Legendary Foods' published label via web (manufacturer/retailer). Reported clearly: 160 kcal, 20g protein, 6g fat, 8g fiber, 0g sugar, ~4g net carb. Total-carb / sugar-alcohol split (~20g / ~8g erythritol) is inferred from net+fiber and flagged. Sodium ~220mg estimated. Verify vs the physical IL wrapper if it differs.

ingredients.item: protein blend (milk protein isolate, dried egg whites, whey protein isolate, sodium caseinate)
modified resistant tapioca starch, natural flavors, cinnamon

steps: Packaged protein donut — eat as-is. A sweet-craving / dessert swap that fits macros.

him.verdict: A dessert that behaves like a protein snack. 20 g protein for just 160 kcal (~12.5 g protein per 100 kcal), 8 g fiber, 0 g sugar, ~4 g net carb — even leaner than the Quest bar for the same protein, and it scratches a sweet/pastry craving. Standout craving-killer on a cut. Same caveats as the other engineered snacks: ultra-processed, leans on erythritol (~8 g) + sucralose; collagen is an incomplete protein but it's blended with complete dairy protein so the amino profile is fine.
flags: 20 g protein / 160 kcal (best protein-per-calorie of the snacks)
suggested_mods: Ideal swap for when you want something sweet/dessert-like without the sugar hit
1 pack at a time — erythritol can bloat if stacked
Slightly better cut pick than the Quest bar on calories; Quest still wins on fiber (14 g vs 8 g)

her_preconception.verdict: Good high-protein, fiber-containing sweet option for her — 20 g protein, 8 g fiber, no sugar. Not a prenatal micronutrient contributor. Sweeteners (erythritol, sucralose) are generally regarded safe in pregnancy in normal amounts; moderate if she prefers to limit them. Contains milk and egg.

safety_advisories.note: Erythritol + sucralose; considered safe in pregnancy in normal amounts. Moderate if limiting non-nutritive sweeteners.

suggested_mods: Occasional sweet/protein top-up; pair with fruit for prenatal micros

adopted_note: Adopted into the rotation 2026-08-09 as a regular sweet/protein snack. Label values, reuse directly: 1 pack (2 donuts, 63 g) = 160 kcal, 20 g protein, 8 g fiber, ~4 g net carb, 0 g sugar. Standing guidance: ~1 pack at a time (erythritol can bloat if stacked). Best protein-per-calorie snack in the rotation.
